key.name: intensity
key.description: 38 gives the design-spec alphas; 0 hides the aura.

key.name: hover-boost
key.summary: Alpha multiplier while the pointer is over an icon

key.name: only-on-hover
key.summary: Show the aura only on hover

key.name: blur-radius
key.summary: Halo blur radius in pixels (at 48px icons)

key.name: accent
key.description: The aura hue is pulled 15% toward it. Bordeaux #8E2A44, Oxblood Noir #A3283A, Merlot Day #7A1C34.

key.name: follow-color-scheme
key.description: Switch the shell theme, GTK theme, preset keys, dark wallpaper, Terminal default profile and GTK colours between the light and the dark variant when org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme changes. install.sh turns it on.

key.name: dark-variant
key.summary: Variant used with Dark Style on

key.name: light-variant
key.summary: Variant used with Dark Style off
